0.0: What's this rosary? It's full of strange energy. Princess Sakuno might need it, so I should bring it to her after the investigation at Hieizan.

no.0: I'm so tired. I don't think I can move a single muscle.

1.0: What is this...? My dreams have been so weird lately. Maybe it's because of Ayame's appearance, but I feel like the Will of the Five Planets is being delivered into my head.
1.1: I can't be completely sure, but I feel like when I look at the rosary you brought, I can start to understand a little as to why.

default.0: The closed temples at Hieizan still need to be searched. If you found something weird, take it to Ayame. I don't have time for this.
